title: TRIAD VAULTS
subtitle: PROCEDURAL CYBER ESCAPE // 1-3 PLAYERS
solo_objective: SOLO MISSION: Step on the pressure plate to open the security barrier.
duo_objective: DUO MISSION: Both agents must step on the 2 pressure plates simultaneously.
squad_objective: SQUAD MISSION: All 3 agents must coordinate and trigger the 3 plates together.
camera_hint: 💡 Tip: Use your Mouse Wheel to Zoom In / Zoom Out.
victory_desc: Progress automatically saved to the Central Security Cloud.
tos_agree: I accept the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
tos_text: Your personal data is protected. Your email is used exclusively for account authentication and password recovery.
tos_privacy_policy_full:
1. Data Collection: Triad Vaults only collects your agent name, encrypted email, and game stats. We do not store cross-tracking data.

2. Agent Cloud Usage: Your progress is synced with the Central Remote Server to ensure you keep your level and prevent duplicate profiles.

3. Conditions: By entering the system, you agree to play in co-op mode without malicious software that alters the experience. We reserve the right to revoke access to offending agents.
lore_footer: Central Remote Server // Agent Cloud // Unique Profiles
no_public_rooms: No public rooms open. Create one!
inst_movement: MOVEMENT: Use W A S D or Arrow Keys to move through the vault.
inst_camera: CAMERA: Use the Mouse Wheel (Scroll) to Zoom In/Out.
inst_objective: OBJECTIVE: Each level has a number of pressure plates equal to the number of players (1 to 3). All agents must step on the plates simultaneously to deactivate the shield.
inst_door: THE EXIT: Once the puzzle is solved, the exit door will reveal its neon beacon. Cross it to escape.
inst_ghost: THE GHOST: A corrupted entity will constantly chase you. Its speed increases each level. Do not let it touch your energy shield!
